subject: contracts/jury-relay version 0.2.0 (not deployed)
method: An AI review agent (Claude Sonnet) copied the crate to a scratch directory, applied one mutation at a time to src/lib.rs, ran cargo test after each and restored the file before the next. Two rounds: before and after the fixes from the first adversarial review.

killed: delete the deadline comparison in on_bet
make the deadline comparison strict, refusing approval exactly at resolve_at_ns
delete the active-status check
accept any status string
delete the bet id comparison
treat a missing bet as passing (let-else that votes)
delete the promise_results_count check
call act_proposal from on_proposal, skipping the escrow read and on_bet (call-site deletion)
use a kind other than the one on_proposal validated
remove the predecessor assertion in on_bet while keeping #[private]
ten more: active-status list members, wrong bet_id passed or read, wrong proposal id to act_proposal, challenge-window check removed, deadline compared with 0, callback gas, result-size cap

survived.why_harmless: the explicit predecessor assertion stays and is tested, so an outside caller is still refused

killed: delete the submission_time < resolve_at_ns refusal (killed by early_filing_is_refused_even_after_deadline)
refuse a filing exactly at the deadline (killed by bet_callback_votes_for_filings_at_deadline_and_after_for_all_active_statuses)
compare submission_time with block_timestamp instead of resolve_at_ns (4 tests failed)
pass 0 instead of the real submission_time from on_proposal (3 tests failed)
delete the referee check (killed by bet_callback_refuses_other_or_null_referee_without_voting)
accept a null referee (same test)
accept any referee account (same test)
run the referee check after building the act_proposal promise (same test)
delete the block_timestamp < resolve_at_ns refusal (killed by bet_callback_refuses_before_deadline_without_voting)
accept a filing 1 ns before the deadline (killed by early_filing_is_refused_even_after_deadline)

survived.mutation: accept block_timestamp equal to resolve_at_ns in on_bet's deadline check
survived.why_harmless: unreachable on chain: approval needs submission_time >= resolve_at_ns and block_timestamp >= submission_time + the 600-second window
